BrochureContent.Content:
Ballyhearny Cottage is a charming four bedroom property tucked away in a beautiful cul de sac location, not much more than a stones throw from the sea. This charming cottage with integral studio apartment has lots to offer the discerning buyer.
Featuring three bedroom accommodation, master en-suite, kitchen/dining, separate living room and utility with a cozy studio apartment to the side.
Standing on circa one acre, the main site and garage/social room occupy approximately 0.5 acres. The adjoining field/paddock is circa a further half acre. A generous garage and spacious social room feature alongside the main cottage and there is a separate shed/store.
Tastefully renovated over the years, this cozy cottage would make a fabulous getaway home or a versatile permanent residence.
Located just a short walk to Chapeltown (800m), school, pub and Church and 4.5km to Knightstown, 4.8km to Portmagee.
Beautiful bijou residence in an outstanding location.
All services connected, turnkey opportunity.
Oil fired central heating, UPVC double glazing, easily maintained grounds affording ample parking and turning.
BER D. BER No: 119622074.
